description: This file contains the implementation of a package decoder for the Go language, specifically for decoding package's Unified IR export data, including classes, methods, and decoding logic.

classes.name: PkgDecoder
classes.description: Provides methods for decoding a package's Unified IR export data, including package path, element data, and section offsets.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: Provides methods for decoding individual element bitstream data, including various data types, relocations, and synchronization.

methods.name: PkgPath
methods.description: Returns the package path for the package being decoded.

methods.name: SyncMarkers
methods.description: Indicates whether the decoder uses sync markers.

methods.name: NewPkgDecoder
methods.description: Initializes a new PkgDecoder with input data and package path.

methods.name: NumElems
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in a given section.

methods.name: TotalElems
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements across all sections.

methods.name: AbsIdx
methods.description: Calculates the absolute index for a given section and index.

methods.name: DataIdx
methods.description: Retrieves raw element bitstream for a section and index.

methods.name: StringIdx
methods.description: Returns string value for a string index.

methods.name: NewDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new Decoder for a section and index, and decodes a sync marker.

methods.name: TempDecoder
methods.description: Creates a temporary Decoder for a section and index, and decodes a sync marker.

methods.name: NewDecoderRaw
methods.description: Creates a raw Decoder for a section and index.

methods.name: TempDecoderRaw
methods.description: Creates a temporary raw Decoder for a section and index.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the bitstream.
